title: Room Inventory
commonDescription: All hotel rooms are equipped with necessary conveniences for a comfortable stay:
commonFeatures: Private bathroom with shower (ROCA, Hansgrohe fixtures)
Individual climate control and ventilation system
LEGRAND sockets with USB ports and 220V
Tea set, tea, sugar, and bottled drinking water
Orthopedic mattress on a bed podium
Work desk, chair, and floor lamp
Hairdryer, towel sets (3 pcs), soap and shower gel dispensers
commonNote: Equipment in specific categories may vary. Additional amenities are detailed in the room description.
addNote: A shared dining area equipped with a microwave and electric kettles is also available on-site
